sloka: तस्याभिवादनं कृत्वा दशग्रीवो निशाचरः ।अब्रवीत्कुशलं पृष्ट्वा हेतुमागमनस्य च ।। ७.२०.२ ॥
transliteration: tasyābhivādanaṁ kṛtvā daśagrīvo niśācaraḥ ।abravītkuśalaṁ pṛṣṭvā hetumāgamanasya ca ।। 7.20.2 ॥

translations.english: Having offered his salutations, Dashagriva, the night-wanderer, spoke after inquiring about his well-being and the reason for his arrival.
